content.text: In regions where traditional payment platforms like PayPal, Stripe, and Gumroad are inaccessible or charging exorbitant fees, digital creators need a reliable solution to accept payments for their ebooks. This guide will walk you through [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/deploying-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-ebook-delivery-12|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-you-19|Deploying a]] a sovereign commerce stack that allows you to accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-first-principles-definitive-breakdown-5|bitcoin]] and other cryptocurrencies for your ebook sales. By leveraging the power of NOWPayments, you can significantly reduce transaction fees and maintain full data ownership while automating delivery, ensuring a seamless experience for your customers.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-11. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Many creators face barriers when using conventional platforms, which can impose high fees and restrictive policies. For example, platforms like Gumroad charge up to 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. If you sell 100 ebooks priced at $97 per month, the fee difference retains $921 in your pocket. This infrastructure eliminates reliance on platforms, allowing you to keep more of your earnings and maintain total control over your content.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you begin the deployment process, gather all necessary resources. You will need a domain for hosting your website, ideally utilizing GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for free hosting. Ensure you have your digital products ready for upload, such as ebooks or templates. Also, set up a NOWPayments account to handle your cryptocurrency transactions efficiently. This preparation ensures a smooth deployment and operational flow for your ecommerce stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by integrating NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing. Follow the integration guide in the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to configure the payment system. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, which automates the delivery of your ebooks upon successful payment confirmation. This setup allows you to handle transactions seamlessly while ensuring your customers receive their products instantly without manual intervention.
Retain more profit by avoiding high platform fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is configured, it's time to go live. Publish your site on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Promote your ebook through social media or email marketing to drive traffic. When a customer makes a purchase, the NOWPayments integration will process the transaction, and the automated delivery system will send the ebook directly to their email. Monitor your dashboard for sales and ensure everything is functioning as expected.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, you can focus on scaling your operations. Consider expanding your product offerings by using the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, allowing you to create more digital products efficiently. Leverage social proof and customer testimonials to attract more buyers. Utilize the data from your transactions to analyze customer preferences and optimize your marketing strategies for better outreach.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate your ebook delivery for a seamless customer experience.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a comprehensive solution to sell digital downloads without relying on restrictive platforms, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It provides everything you need to build and deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack efficiently.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions

You can sell an ebook online by using a sovereign commerce stack that includes GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This setup eliminates the need for traditional payment platforms.

The best way to sell digital downloads without incurring platform fees is to use NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, which charges only 0.5%. This significantly reduces costs compared to platforms like Gumroad.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up your own ecommerce infrastructure using GitHub Pages and NOWPayments. This allows you to retain full control over your products and profits.
How do I automate delivery of my ebooks?
You can automate the delivery of your ebooks by using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These tools will trigger an automatic delivery process once a payment is confirmed through NOWPayments.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my ebook sales?
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies for your ebook sales. This offers flexibility for your customers and can potentially increase your sales volume.
Maintain full control over your digital products and customer data.
